title: A silence and picking the thread back up
summary: A pause, remarks about not feeling free to talk while being recorded, and Morgenstern recapping where they left off.

blocks.x: You see what I mean by knowing that you're doing this thing. You can't think or talk.
It's true. It's true. You don't feel free.
Then you just have to forget about it.
